newsitem.title: JAPAN: Top Japan builders to post appraisal losses - paper.
newsitem.headline: Top Japan builders to post appraisal losses - paper.

text.p: Japan's top four construction companies are estimated to have posted about 20 billion yen in appraisal losses on securities holdings in 1996/97, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Friday.
Of the four companies, Taisei Corp, Kajima Corp and Obayashi Corp each had about four billion yen in losses and Shimizu Corp had eight billion yen in losses, the paper said.
Taisei and Kajima were likely to have absorbed most of the losses by selling part of their stock holdings, the paper said.
A spokesman for Taisei said the loss would be a little more than three billion yen, less than the paper reported, and denied that the company specifically sold stock to cover those losses.
A spokesman for Kajima confirmed that the company's appraisal loss was estimated at four billion yen in the last business year, but he did not say how the loss would be covered.
A spokesman for Shimizu was not immediately available to comment and an Obayashi spokesman declined to comment.
